name: valslide-leg-curl
instructions:
1. Set up in a supine position with your hands by your side, knees bent, and feet placed on valslides.
2. Extend your hips by contracting your glutes and then slowly extend your legs until they’re almost parallel with the floor.
3. Contract your hamstrings to pull your heels towards your butt.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
